data.comment: You don't choose the Equipment to destroy until Light of Judgment is resolving.
Light of Judgment can target a creature that has no Equipment attached to it.
If the target creature is an illegal target when Light of Judgment tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will happen. You won't destroy any Equipment.
Unforge deals damage only to the creature that the Equipment was attached to when the Equipment was destroyed. It doesn’t deal damage to creatures that the Equipment had previously equipped.
